main_measure.name: mean 10-bar fwd return on short blocks minus all blocks (pooled, %)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if <= -1.0% per 10 bars with t <= -2 (Welch, non-overlapping blocks); reject if >= 0; inconclusive in between or |t| < 2

supporting_check.name: falling share on short blocks minus unconditional (points, need >= 10)

decided_by: Rejected: the conditional-minus-unconditional difference is 0 or above, or the falling share on short bars is not above the unconditional share.
reading: Non-overlapping 10-bar blocks start at each window's first bar, a block is short when the forecast at its start bar is below 0, the t-stat is Welch's t between short-block and all-block returns, and a downward cross is a forecast move from >= 0 to < 0 inside a window.
